audit.why: Lane difficulty is fairly represented: Syndra bullies early with 800-range Q while Katarina is a mana-less melee with no pre-dagger trade; Katarina's threat is post-6 resets and roams. Difficulty 5.5/10 EVEN matches the 47.4% Emerald+ win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer gave Syndra all 7 stages while she wins 47.4% overall — the packet flags this defect. Full layer had Skill on 6 of 7 rows so the two layers disagreed on rows 0-3, 5 and 6.
audit.why: Kit-grounded: Syndra genuinely wins levels 1-5 (Q 800 range poke vs a melee whose only entry, Shunpo 12s CD, is answered by E stun) and level 6 (E interrupts the Death Lotus channel). Item stages even out: Katarina's reset pattern and 45s rank-3 R make late fights coin-flips the win rate reflects.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 aligned to Syndra on both layers; rows 5-6 aligned to Skill on both layers; row 4 stays Syndra.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no cooldown number; several fields called Katarina 'he/his'; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Key interactions verified from kits: Shunpo (E, 12/11/10/9/8s) is a blink Syndra's E stun punishes; Death Lotus (R, 75/60/45s) is a channel any CC — including Scatter the Weak — cancels on reaction; Katarina's Q is a projectile and her passive resets cooldowns on takedowns, so denying the first kill denies the chain. Syndra E is 15s flat, R 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries the real numbers; pronouns corrected to she/her; bleed bullets rewritten to match their titles.

audit.why: Common-mistakes content (spending E on poke, standing sphere-less, chasing past stun CD) is Katarina-specific and correct.
